</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="1112-div1"><a href="https://codeforces.com/contest/2249" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">1112 div1</a></h2>
<p><span class="math inline">\(C\)</span> 忘记了用<strong>连通块</strong>刻画<strong>连续段</strong>，没想到<strong>点边容斥</strong>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(F\)</span> 中 <span class="math inline">\(i \in [0,2^x-1],popcount_k(i)\)</span> 构成的字符串具有倍增的递推关系。</p>
<h3 id="a-rank-subsequence"><a href="https://codeforces.com/contest/2249/problem/A" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">A. Rank Subsequence</a></h3>
<p>给定长度为 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 的序列 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span>。其中第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个元素在子序列中时，满足子序列中在其之前的元素个数不属于 <span class="math inline">\([l_i,r_i]\)</span>，子序列中在其之后的元素个数不属于 <span class="math inline">\([u_i,v_i]\)</span>。求最长子序列长度。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(1 \le \sum n \le 5 \times 10^3,2s,256MB\)</span>。</p>
<hr>
<h4 id="1">1</h4>
<p>定义 <span class="math inline">\(f_{i,j}\)</span> 表示考虑前 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 个元素子序列长度为 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span> 是否可行。</p>
<p>发现无法转移，因为不知道后面有多少元素。所以从大到小枚举子序列长度 <span class="math inline">\(len\)</span>，然后再 <span class="math inline">\(dp\)</span>。</p>
<p>时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^3)\)</span>。</p>
<h4 id="2">2</h4>
<p>套路地，<strong>考虑转 <span class="math inline">\(01\)</span> 为最值</strong>。具体地，注意到 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 中有值部分是一个<strong>前缀</strong>，所以改变状态，定义 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 表示有值前缀的右端点。状态优化成 <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span>。</p>
<p>注意到只有 <span class="math inline">\(f_i\)</span> 处的转移有效，所以转移也优化成 <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span>。</p>
<p>时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(n^2)\)</span>。</p>
<h3 id="b-permutation-cuts"><a href="https://codeforces.com/contest/2249/problem/B" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">B. Permutation Cuts</a></h3>
<p>对一个 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 阶排列 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(\forall i \in [1,n-1],a_i = \min(\max_{j \le i}\{p_j\},\max_{j \ge i+1}\{p_j\})\)</span>。</p>
<p>现在给定 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span>，求有多少种合法的 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 阶排列 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(2 \le \sum n \le 10^6,4s,256MB\)</span>。</p>
<hr>
<h4 id="1-1">1</h4>
<p>定义 <span class="math inline">\(pm_i = \max_{j \le i}\{p_j\},sm_i = \max_{j \ge i}\{p_j\}\)</span>。</p>
<p>考察一个 <span class="math inline">\(a_i\)</span> 对 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 的限制。相当于 <span class="math inline">\(sm_{i+1} \gt pm_i = a_i\)</span> 或者 <span class="math inline">\(pm_i \gt sm_{i+1} = a_i\)</span>。</p>
<p>考察 <span class="math inline">\(a_i = v\)</span> 的 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 构成的集合 <span class="math inline">\(g_1,g_2,\cdots,g_n\)</span>。</p>
<p>当 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 放在 <span class="math inline">\([g_i+1,g_{i+1}]\)</span> 时，你发现 <span class="math inline">\(g_i\)</span> 要求 <span class="math inline">\(pm_{g_i} \gt v\)</span>，但是 <span class="math inline">\(g_{i+1}\)</span> 要求 <span class="math inline">\(pm_{g_{i+1}} = v\)</span>,矛盾。</p>
<p>所以 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 只能位于 <span class="math inline">\([1,g_1]\)</span> 或者 <span class="math inline">\([g_n+1,n]\)</span>。以 <span class="math inline">\(v\)</span> 在 <span class="math inline">\([1,g_1]\)</span> 为例，发现限制最强的是 <span class="math inline">\(g_n\)</span>，即要求 <span class="math inline">\(sm_{g_n+1} \gt pm_{g_n} = v\)</span>。</p>


</div>
